title: Copilot Extension
tagline: Creating a vision crypto copilot. Your friend in the trenches.
description:
A browser extension that combines a secure crypto wallet with an AI-powered assistant using Gemini Flash 2.0. Your personal guide through the crypto space, capable of analyzing both text and visual content to provide informed assistance.

Secure Wallet Management

Local encrypted storage of wallet credentials
Mnemonic phrase generation
Password-protected access
AI Assistant

Text and visual analysis using Gemini Flash 2.0
Real-time screenshot processing
Context-aware responses
Markdown support for better readability
how_its_made:
### **Technical Stack 🏗️**  

- **Frontend:** Built with **React.js**, ensuring a dynamic and responsive user experience.  
- **Blockchain Integration:** Powered by **Viem**, enabling seamless Ethereum wallet operations with optimized RPC handling.  
- **Security & Encryption:** Utilizes the **Web Crypto API** for robust, client-side cryptographic functions.  
- **AI Integration:** Connected via **OpenRouter API**, unlocking advanced AI-driven interactions.  
- **Browser Compatibility:** Leverages **Chrome/Firefox Extension APIs** for deep browser integration and enhanced functionality.
